item.text:
REVIEW_DECISION: REJECT
RISK_CLASS: high-impact
SUMMARY: Receipt provenance is self-asserted rather than harness-authenticated, so fabricated execution and Sol/Opus review receipts can satisfy the validators.
FINDING: critical|scripts/factory-ng-provenance-validate.py|The validator trusts receipt fields such as recorded_by, reviewer_profile, provider, and resolved_model plus a self-computable digest; it verifies no harness-controlled signature or trusted-store identity|A model or producer can manufacture immutable-looking accepted receipts and thereby self-certify gates and required reviews, violating Factory-only acceptance and integration authority.
REQUIRED_CHANGE: Bind execution and review receipts to a harness-controlled attestation that producers cannot create, such as a verified signature/key identity or trusted append-only receipt-store reference, and require validators to verify that attestation.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: A producer creates two distinct review receipts claiming registered Sol and Opus identities, sets recorded_by to factory-harness/v1, matches package_sha256, computes their hashes, and submits an accepted high-impact provenance record; the current validator accepts it without either reviewer or the harness having run.
